title: rekey leaves removed admins on the admin roster
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py

spec/12-apps.md 18.8.2 Roles: Admins are always members. Removal by owner/admin plus rekey must drop the removed node from the authoritative roster.

rekey() (240-272) when removed_member is not the owner:
- filters item[\"members\"]
- pops item[\"invitations\"][removed_member]
- does not touch item[\"admins\"]

requester_role (378-389) checks owner, then admins, then members. A removed admin therefore still returns \"admin\".

Impact on this resource:
- _roster_view_authorized still treats them as affiliated
- GET /groups/{id} includes members/admins for that pairwise identity
- GET /groups/{id}/members returns 2.05 instead of 4.03

test_rekey_never_strips_owner covers owner only. test_rekey_on_member_removal uses a member, not an admin. join_key admin promotion (test_join_key_admin_invitation_promotes_admin) has no corresponding removal path.
acceptance_criteria: rekey(removed_member=X) where X is not the owner MUST drop X from members and admins and keep requester_role(X) is None. Owner is still never stripped. Tests: promote admin, rekey(removed_member=admin), admin pairwise GET /members is 4.03, admins list no longer contains them, owner remains a member.
close_reason: Rekey now atomically removes non-owner identities from current members, admins, and invitations while rotating keys; stale persisted admin-only entries fail closed. Rust parity preserves owners and removes admins. Added authorization, last-admin, entropy retry, concurrent epoch, persistence, and owner regressions; group/OSCORE tests, Ruff, focused mypy, Rust tests/clippy/package fmt passed.
